name: print-social-blue-story-frames-lunchbox-brain-and-wave-transition
title: Four blue vertical story frames: yellow lunchbox, mint wave transition, glowing brain and a tub with benefit chips
whatItIs: A strip of four tall royal-blue frames on crumpled paper: a serif 'Lunchbox coming back full?' with a yellow 3D lunchbox, a blank frame with a mint wave rising, a glowing pink brain with a light streak and a product tub ringed by white benefit chips with emoji.
whatItMeans: Playful and rhythmic; the mint wave is a transition that ties frames together.
techniques: Use a rising wave as a transition.
Ring a product with benefit chips.
Keep serif headlines with a green keyword.

vocabulary.definition: A wave shape moving up to change scenes.
Frames of an animation shown in sequence.
A white label with an emoji and benefit.
A 3D object with a radiating light.
